description.zh: 上游 kokonutui 的真实组件 loader 在本地沙箱中的实际渲染；3 个可调参数：title、subtitle、尺寸。
description.en: Animated loading indicator with rotating gradient rings, size variants and customizable title text. Built with React and Tailwind CSS. Rendered from the original source at commit 4d497b7b03f02ffd07225e638c0b9ace3f892dbb.
